name: Zillethai
overview: Zillethai was a male descendant of the tribe of Manasseh who played a significant military role during the time of King David. He was known as a captain of thousands who defected to David, demonstrating loyalty and leadership. His arrival at Ziklag marked an important moment in the consolidation of David's forces.
namesAndTitles: The name Zillethai means "shadow of y-h-v-h," reflecting a theophoric element that acknowledges the presence or protection of the Lord. This proper name, as recorded in 1 Chronicles 12:20, does not indicate that it was given directly by God but carries spiritual significance.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies Zillethai as a descendant of Manasseh, linking him to one of the tribes of Israel. Beyond this tribal affiliation, no additional family relationships are recorded in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Zillethai's significance lies in his role as a military leader who joined David at Ziklag, bringing with him a substantial following as captain of thousands. His defection to David's side contributed to the strengthening of David's kingdom and demonstrated the gathering support from various tribes, including Manasseh, during a pivotal period in Israel's history.
